goal: Close audit P0-2: branch evaluations must bind to an execution-receipt chain (candidate digest, generation ids, composition digest, session identity, external state digests, grader receipt) instead of accepting arbitrary state files.

acceptance_criteria.statement: execution-receipt.v1 schema lands with the full digest chain; validation is secret/PII-scanned.

evaluateBranch accepts --receipt, requires the receipt's external_state_after_sha256 to equal the graded state digest (BRANCH_RECEIPT_MISMATCH otherwise), and records receipt_id/receipt_sha256/provenance_valid; receipt-less evaluations are provenance-invalid.
Additive schema changes; the full gate passes on the branch.

outcome.summary: Execution receipts shipped: branch evaluations now distinguish provenance-valid (receipt-bound) from unbound scores, closing the hand-written-perfect-JSON loophole the review identified.

what_worked: The binding rule is a single digest equality (receipt.external_state_after_sha256 == graded state digest), which keeps the security argument small and testable.
The CLI change is one optional flag; every existing branch evaluation keeps working but is now honestly marked provenance-invalid.

calls.name: receipt-chain
calls.purpose: Add the execution-receipt schema, validator, evaluateBranch binding, CLI option, and evaluation schema fields.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Three tests: receipt schema validation, bound evaluation with provenance fields, mismatch rejection, and receipt-less provenance-invalid marking.
Typecheck, build, 151 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed on improvements/audit-borrows.

uncertainty.statement: Nothing produces receipts yet; the e2e driver must emit them (candidate skill digest, composition digest, service state before/after digests, grader verdict digest) during the G0/G1 demo.
uncertainty.resolution: The driver-side receipt production is the demo-round wiring, using the schema and binding rule now in place.

notes: Deterministic implementation and tests only; no model calls, external transfers, or approvals this round.
